extracted.name: How to cook brussels sprouts
extracted.description: Serve the perfect side of brussels sprouts at Christmas with our classic recipe. Plus, read our tips on buying, cooking and freezing this gorgeous green veg, along with alternative recipe suggestions.
ingredient_lines: 750g brussels sprouts trimmed, any large ones halved or quartered
instruction_lines: Tip the brussels sprouts into a pan and add a couple of cm water and a pinch of salt – a large pan works better so they're not piled up too high. Cover and bring the water to the boil, turn down to a simmer and cook with the lid on for 3- 5 mins depending on size.
Test with a sharp knife to see if they are cooked through. If not, cook for a little longer and test again.
Drain and tip the sprouts into a bowl. Serve with a knob of butter, if you wish.
